mappingBasis: Preserve the source domain where provided. Supplemental guide/legacy questions receive a reviewed primary domain based on the deciding skill. This local question mapping is not a Microsoft classification. Weights describe the exam, not the proportions of our bank.

domains.title: Planning & management
domains.description: Choose, deploy, secure and operate Azure AI solutions.
skills: Select suitable models, services, retrieval approaches and knowledge integration.
Set up infrastructure, deployments and delivery pipelines.
Manage capacity, costs, identity, network access and service health.
Apply safety policies, auditing and oversight.

domains.title: Generative AI & agents
domains.description: Build and improve generative applications and agent workflows.
skills: Connect applications to Foundry and implement grounded generation.
Build agents with tools, memory, orchestration and approval controls.
Improve prompts and model behaviour; evaluate and trace application runs.

domains.title: Computer vision
domains.description: Generate, edit and understand visual media safely.
skills: Generate and edit images and video with appropriate controls.
Interpret visual evidence, captions, regions and video segments.
Apply visual safety policies and defend against embedded instructions.

domains.title: Text analysis & speech
domains.description: Extract meaning from text and enable speech-based interactions.
skills: Analyze, summarize, redact and translate text using suitable tools or models.
Implement recognition, synthesis, translation and audio-based agent interactions.

domains.title: Information extraction
domains.description: Build retrieval pipelines and extract useful content from documents.
skills: Ingest, enrich and index content for hybrid, semantic and vector retrieval.
Extract OCR, layout, fields and grounded outputs from documents.
